verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents streams that record DML changes so actions can be taken on the changed data (incremental CDC). Dynamic tables are listed as a GA feature, and dbt Projects on Snowflake lets you develop, deploy and orchestrate transformations in-platform on managed runtimes. A community user also refers to incremental dbt models on Snowflake. missing for 10: no evidence of tasks or scheduling to drive stream consumption, dynamic tables appear only as a release-note title with no description of declarative incremental refresh, no continuous-query semantics or latency details, no hands-on corroboration of a running continuous pipeline.
